description: Duskmaw v4 - the shadow lord (2026-09-26 v4: the maw carved into a curving slender trunk with a jagged upper lip line, floor tendrils, clawed wispy arms; colours unchanged from v3). v3 - the shadow figure (artist 2026-09-25 v2: Aku / Father (KND) / Darkrai; 2026-09-26 v3: 'the body mouth should look more like this (and colored red) with the inside just a different shade of yellow orange so we can tell its inside'). Near-black violet body; the eyes are the face's only feature (no mouth under them); a blood-red frame and red jagged teeth round the chest maw; the inside of the maw yellow-orange, hottest at the throat; the base's shadow tendrils darker still. v2's palette (dark-red inside, ember-orange teeth) is in git history.

body.note: near-black violet shadow body, hat, arms

base.note: v4: the floor tendrils curling out along the ground (+ the hem skin outside the base surface) - darker than the body; the build darkens everything below BASE_Z further toward the floor

tips.note: smouldering spike tips (claws, arm wisps, shoulder spikes, hat) - dim so the maw and eyes lead

lip.note: blood-red frame round the maw (the drawn red outline)

teeth.note: the jagged teeth - red like the frame, a shade brighter so each tooth edge reads

maw_inner.note: inside of the mouth: yellow-orange (cavity walls under the lips, the teeth's backs)

maw_throat.note: the back of the mouth: hot yellow glow

eyes.note: Father-style hot glowing slit eyes - the face's only feature

grin.note: unused since v3 (no mouth under the eyes: the geometry has no grin region); kept so the old grin.json variant file still loads
